## Reading timers

A button `pb` (push button, true while pressed) drives a `TON`, a `TOF` and a `TP` in parallel, all set to 2 s: their outputs are `q_ton`, `q_tof` and `q_tp`. There is nothing to write or modify.

### Sequence of presses on `pb`

| Press | Start | End |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 (long) | 1 s | 5 s |
| 2 (short: less than PT) | 8 s | 9 s |
| 3 (during the `TP` pulse) | 9.5 s | 12 s |

### Task

1. Without starting the simulation, draw the timing diagram of the three outputs for this sequence on paper.
2. Start the simulation, reproduce the sequence with `pb` (to within one second) and compare with the outputs.
